services.name: Osprey Sightseeing Cruise
services.desc: Welcome aboard the m/v Osprey, Wilmington's newest tour vessel. You will be cruising on the Cape Fear River that was considered the south’s life line during the civil war and is equally important today. Rates Adult (13+): $20 Child (2-12): $5 Baby (younger than 2): Free Duration 90 minutes About On this 90 Minute Sightseeing Cruise, you will get the chance to learn about: The importance of the Cape Fear River The local marine, bird and animal life The history of the area from discovery to the present Our experienced Captains take pride in their personalization of the narration. While waiting to board one of our vessels you can relax in our covered waiting area and enjoy a beverage or snack

services.name: Cape Fear Sightseeing Cruise
services.desc: All aboard! Cruise the Cape Fear River for a relaxing sightseeing cruise aboard the Henrietta. About the tour Enjoy the view from our covered upper deck or from the air-conditioned lower deck while you enjoy this live narrated scenic 1 hour cruise departing from historic downtown Wilmington, NC. On this 1 Hour Sightseeing Cruise, you will get the chance to learn about:# - The importance of the Cape Fear River and the local marine, bird and animal life Historical overview of the area from discovery to present times Hear about Hollywood's use of Wilmington as frequent backdrop for well known shows and films. Learn about the pirate history of the coast as well as the role the river played

services.name: Sunset River Cruise
services.desc: All aboard! Come enjoy a drink with friends and catch the sunset with our crew featuring our new boat The Henrietta. Book now to reserve your spot! Duration 1.5 Hours About -Full bar -Covered top deck -Air conditioned dining area -Spectacular views of downtown, the port, and the river

services.name: Black River Nature Cruise
services.desc: Prepare to be amazed by the tranquility and breathtaking scenery along the northwest Cape Fear River and the Black River. Experience the beauty and natural history of the Cape Fear region during a narrated nature cruise along these scenic and historic coastal rivers aboard the Henrietta. Our narrator is Andy Wood, a well known Coastal Ecologist and Author. Duration 4 Hours About On this 4 hour Black River Nature Cruise, just minutes after leaving the dock, guests will experience: Miles of scenic wilderness Narration on the plant and wildlife And a river that appears almost as it did to the early explorers! services.name: New Years Eve Cruise Aboard the Henrietta
services.desc: Welcome aboard! Join us aboard the Henrietta for a fantastic New Year's Celebration. This cruise will include light hors d'oeuvres and music provided by DJ Kysheem Remix. Enjoy dancing on the open air top deck or seated comfort on the enclosed lower deck. Champagne toast and party favors will be included for all guests. VIP Boarding starts at 9:00 PM and cruising will be 10:00PM - 12:30 AM. There will be light appetizers for you to enjoy but this is not a dinner cruise. Dance to your favorite tunes played by our DJ Kysheem Remix and enjoy downtown Wilmington's beautifully lit skyline. Drinks will be available at our fully stocked bar.
